entities.summary: John Gilmore is an American activist. He is one of the founders of the Electronic Frontier Foundation, the Cypherpunks mailing list, and Cygnus Solutions. He created the alt.* hierarchy in Usenet and is a major contributor to the GNU Project. John Gilmore was a architects & engineers from York (b. 1955, York). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
